-Bronze Tier

   -A major bug was found that accidently doubled the power of all towers.

notes.title: Tournament Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,
I took in a bunch of feedback from Steam and mobile users. This release is a result of that.

New Tournament
  -Players are now divided into blocks of 30.
  -The top 10 players of a block will be promoted to a new tier, if one exists.
  -The bottom 10 players will be demoted to the previous tier, if one exists.

I also finished converting all the text to textmesh, which let me remove a bunch of redundant fonts. This made the game size a lot smaller. The side effect is some text might be missing. Let me know if you see that.

Please email me with any issues you find at support@wafflestackstudio.com

notes.title: Tournament Mode Added
notes.notes:
Hi all,
This update synchronizes the steam version with the latest Android release. iOS will follow shortly. At the moment, the tournament is only supported on the vertical view. Horizontal view will follow sometime in the future.

-NEW TOURNAMENT MODE

   -Ladder resets every Saturday and Tuesday at UTC0 at midnight
   -Earn a new currency to get even more powerups!
   -Multiple Tiers of increasing difficulty and reward

notes.title: Horizontal Orientation is now available
notes.notes:
Hello All,
This release will allow players to use the horizontal view by selecting tapping "Change Orientation" in the settings. The beta testers and I spent quite a few weeks going over it, and I think it's in a good state now to release to everyone. I've decided to keep supporting the older view because I personally like it, and it's the identical view for mobile anyway. 

In addition, limits have been increased on the gold upgrades and the upgrade point damage multipliers. In testing, this allowed me and other beta testers to clear Tier 2, Level 10. The gold upgrade speed will also increase rapidly if you press and hold it.

This is pretty much what I set out to do for early access, so after a few days I'll release this if no issues are brought up. I'll do some more giveaways on the discord to celebrate. For those on the discord, keep an eye out for some new prototypes of my next game. I have a few ideas, so those will be coming out soon.

Feel free to reach me at support@wafflestackstudio.com, or through [url=https://discord.com/invite/cyXgpPz]discord[/url] for any issues or concerns.

notes.title: Beta Branch "playfabtesting" Ready for Testing
notes.notes:
Hi all,

The beta branch "playfabtesting" is now ready to test. I'm excited about this update that will allow users to share saved files across different platforms. Testing is as easy as joining the [url=https://towerball.wafflestackstudio.com/home/steam-beta]beta group[/url] and the beta program on the Android app. Then you just need to create an account and log into that account from your other devices to access your saved files. Here is a basic guide on how the account features work: https://towerball.wafflestackstudio.com/home/account 

Feel free to reach me at support@wafflestackstudio.com, or through [url=https://discord.gg/cyXgpPz]discord[/url] for any issues or concerns while testing. Please include your playfab ID and a description of your issue. I expect this to be released this Saturday or Sunday at the earliest if there are no major issues and I manage to defeat my tall vampire waifu. So far it seems to be working great. iOS development will follow shortly behind.  

Lastly, there's been some new changes around the boss, particle effects optimization, and bug fixes. Here's the full changelog for release 340: https://towerball.wafflestackstudio.com/home/change-log.

Thanks,
Justin
